scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor
scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p public/vendor/fontawesome/css public/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts public/vendor/alpinejs public/vendor/js-yaml && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css public/vendor/fontawesome/css/all.min.css && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/* public/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts/ && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js public/vendor/alpinejs/cdn.min.js && cp node_modules/js-yaml/dist/browser/js-yaml.umd.min.js public/vendor/js-yaml/js-yaml.min.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run setup-kv && wrangler deploy
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run smoke && npm audit && npm outdated
